data.title: Wine cultivar: train and serve
data.summary: The shortest complete loop: read a CSV, train a random forest, score it on held-out data and deploy it as a live endpoint.

sample_dataset.description: 178 wines from three cultivars, 13 chemical measurements each; predict the `cultivar` column.
sample_dataset.source: Wine, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.description: Reads the wine sample, keeps a quarter of it aside for testing, standardises the training features and fits a random forest. The evaluator scores the model on the untouched test split (accuracy, macro F1, confusion matrix) while the serve step deploys the registered model as `example-wine-forest`. Once the run finishes, the model is under Models and the endpoint under Model Serving.

data.title: Diagnosis: three-model bake-off
data.summary: Train logistic regression, an SVM and gradient boosting side by side on the same split and compare their test scores.

sample_dataset.description: 569 breast-tissue samples with 30 cell-nucleus measurements; predict the `diagnosis` column (malignant or benign).
sample_dataset.source: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.description: One read, split and normalize feed three learners that run in parallel. Each learner gets its own evaluator on the same test split, so the run page shows the three metric sets next to each other. All three models are registered; pick the best one and serve it from Models.

data.title: Handwritten digits: image classifier
data.summary: Read a zip of labelled images, train a support vector classifier on their pixels, evaluate it and serve it.

sample_dataset.description: 1,797 handwritten digits as 8x8 greyscale PNGs, one folder per digit 0-9.
sample_dataset.source: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.description: The image reader turns a zip of one folder per class into 8x8 RGB arrays, the digits' own size. The SVM trains on the normalized, flattened pixels of the training split; the evaluator applies the same normalization to the test split before scoring. The serve step deploys the model as `example-digits-svm`. For a convolutional network, swap the SVM for the CNN image classifier component.

component.name: SVM classifier

data.title: Wine: parameterised retrain and redeploy
data.summary: Hyperparameters and the endpoint name are pipeline parameters: change them in Manage Parameters and rerun to retrain and replace the live model.

sample_dataset.description: 178 wines from three cultivars, 13 chemical measurements each; predict the `cultivar` column.
sample_dataset.source: Wine, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.description: Same data path as the train-and-serve example, with gradient boosting as the learner. `n_estimators`, `learning_rate` and `service_name` are pipeline parameters rather than step constants, so every rerun can try new values without touching the graph. Serving under an existing `service_name` replaces that endpoint with the newly trained model.
